query: Every time I run swaymsg reload I end up with two (or three) copies of my status daemon running. I start it with exec_always in my config. What's wrong?
expected_behavior: Explains that exec_always runs again on every reload, so the daemon is re-spawned each time without the old one being killed
Gives the fix: the launcher must pkill/kill the existing instance before exec'ing a fresh one (pkill -f then exec daemon), not rely on exec_always alone
Notes that reload does NOT reset running processes / window positions
notes: Classic sway wall: users assume exec_always replaces the previous instance on reload. It doesn't — it just runs the line again, stacking duplicate daemons. The skill documents the kill-then-exec pattern.
